output.reason: The linked PR [ev-a42bf00d3581] says the defect was that the Helm connect page checked the type of bearerToken even when it was not set ("We should not perform type checking when bearerToken is not set"). Only the repos-list UI component changed [ev-d7daab778767][ev-912017649c04]. So the affected case is a Helm repository connected through the UI without a bearer token, not one connected with a bearer token as the proposal says. No configuration can show how people use the UI, so an undecidable runtime leaf is the right form, but the 'needed' text must name the right group of users.

correction.statement: Argo CD 3.0.0 fixes the Helm repository connect page in the UI so it no longer type-checks bearerToken when no bearer token is set. Exposure depends on whether users add Helm repositories through the UI without a bearer token, which no configuration shows.

exposure.needed: whether users connect Helm repositories through the Argo CD UI connect page without setting a bearer token
